digest.component_or_area: alert_store and binding-snapshot commit seam consolidation
propositions: alert_store._atomic_write hand-rolls tempfile+os.replace instead of the shared fsutil.atomic_write seam
alert_store residency is local scratch (bridge_state/bridge_alerts is git-ignored); only atomic_write is needed, no commit/publish path

binding-snapshot commit path conversion to push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch would require git add -A which sweeps in .bridge_state/last-pass.json and breaks reconcile idempotency by creating redundant commits on unchanged passes
alert_store conversion must preserve exact byte-identity, 0o600 file mode, and fsync-before-replace durability with an explicit parent.mkdir call before fsutil.atomic_write

binding-snapshot path must remain unchanged with selective 5-file staging to preserve idempotency; a seam pathspec parameter or write-lock-wrapped selective-commit helper would be required to route it through commit_and_push_tickets_branch without breaking the idempotency contract
